title: Main board - U1, U15, J14: strap pads and meter points (raptox's unit, mosaic 2026-11-03)
source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)

callouts.label: J14 pin 1, common row
callouts.note: Common row, one net with R577 (J-098); 3V3 via R577: to measure (chapter 1). Top of the left column, by the printed dot and the '1'.

callouts.label: J14 pin 2, common row
callouts.note: Common row, one net with R577 (J-098); 3V3 via R577: to measure (chapter 1).

callouts.label: J14 pin 3, common row
callouts.note: Common row, one net with R577 (J-098); 3V3 via R577: to measure (chapter 1).

callouts.label: J14 pin 4
callouts.note: Not connected (J-098). Bottom of the left column, '4' printed below.

callouts.label: J14 pin 5
callouts.note: Not connected (J-098). Bottom of the right column, '5' printed below.

callouts.label: J14 pin 6, to X6
callouts.note: To X6: beeper (J-098; the pair stated in J-268).

callouts.label: J14 pin 7, to X5
callouts.note: To X5: beeper (J-098; the pair stated in J-268).

callouts.label: J14 pin 8, to X4
callouts.note: To X4: beeper (J-098; the pair stated in J-268). Top of the right column, '8' printed above.

callouts.label: Strap pad X4 = SOP0 (U1 pin 35; J14 pin 8), cap to GND
callouts.note: SOP0: beeper to U1 pin 35, raptox 2026-11-05 (J-137). J14 pin 8 by the mosaic order (J-098, likely). Never pulled high together with the other of X4/X5 before the backup (SOP 011 = factory restore).

callouts.label: Strap pad X5 = SOP1 (U1 pin 34; J14 pin 7), cap to GND
callouts.note: SOP1: beeper to U1 pin 34, raptox 2026-11-05 (J-137). J14 pin 7 by the mosaic order (J-098, likely). Never pulled high together with the other of X4/X5 before the backup (SOP 011 = factory restore).

callouts.label: Strap pad X6 = SOP2 (U1 pin 21; J14 pin 6), cap to GND
callouts.note: SOP2: beeper to U1 pin 21, raptox 2026-11-05 (J-137). J14 pin 6 by the mosaic order (J-098, likely). The UARTLOAD strap goes here: 3V3 via 470 Ohm from U15 pin 8.

callouts.label: U1 pin 21, SOP2
callouts.note: Beeper touch point: toe at the package edge, 5th pin from the left on the bottom edge. Counted from the pin-1 dot (callout 20); function per SWAS035C pin mux.

callouts.label: U1 pin 32, nRESET
callouts.note: nRESET, last pin on the bottom edge (right). Toe at the package edge.

callouts.label: U1 pin 34, SOP1
callouts.note: SOP1, 2nd from the bottom on the right edge. Toe at the package edge.

callouts.label: U1 pin 35, SOP0
callouts.note: SOP0, 3rd from the bottom on the right edge. Toe at the package edge.

callouts.label: U15 pin 1, CS#
callouts.note: Flash chip select (J-108): 4.7 kOhm to ESP32 GPIO4 in the recorder setup. The leg at the moulded dimple, beside the two white silkscreen dots (bottom-left in this view); pins 1-4 run along this row, 5-8 back along the other.

callouts.label: U15 pin 4, GND
callouts.note: GND (J-080, J-108): the GND meter point nearest U1. Last leg of pin 1's row (bottom-right in this view).

callouts.label: U15 pin 8, VCC = 3V3 (J-110)
callouts.note: 10k/10k divider to ESP32 GPIO36; the 470 Ohm strap's source in the UARTLOAD session; the 3.3 V meter point. The leg across from pin 1 (top-left in this view).

callouts.label: R577, common-row pull
callouts.note: 0603 just above J14's pin-1 end, right of its label. Its right end is on the common row (J-098); the other end to measure (3V3 expected, guess).

callouts.label: U1 pin-1 mark
callouts.note: Moulded dot at the top-left corner of U1. Pins count counter-clockwise from here: 1-16 down the left edge, 17-32 left to right along the bottom, 33-48 up the right edge, 49-64 right to left along the top (SWAS035C figure 7-1).
